LG_M50T_ECN.name: LG M50T

entropy.status: Published PyECN lookup; independently unvalidated here

geometry.status: Manufacturer maximum dimensions and mass, draft Rev 0

operating_limits.source_revision: 2018-07-16 Rev 0 draft; temperature-dependent current limits in sections 4.2.3 and 4.2.4

thermal_defaults.status: Declared fixture assumptions, not a validated cell property set

source.interpretation: Unscaled whole-cell resistance/capacitance tables. No 4680 electrode-area or module scaling. Capacity_rated0=18000 coulombs is 5 Ah.

LG_M50T_ECN.evidence_status: Published temperature-dependent model; independent experimental assessment pending
limitations: Same-cell-type parameter import does not establish batch-specific accuracy.
Surface-equivalent thermal network uses declared fixture assumptions.
No ageing model or core-temperature validation.

SAMSUNG_30T.name: Samsung 30T

operating_limits.status: 6 A prototype modelling limit; 35 A manufacturer rating applies at 25 C and is not a blanket model-accuracy claim

thermal_defaults.status: Assumed 1000 J/kg/K specific heat and declared fixture conductance; not independently identified

source.boundary_policy: Regression trends extend from condition means to the measured calibration-temperature extrema; no extension beyond those observations. These fitted boundary parameters are estimates, not extra measurements.
source.current_convention: Original positive charge converted to positive discharge
source.procedure: IR-corrected C/20 reference; isolated discharge-pulse and sustained conditioning/rest 3-RC regressions with fixed 2/30/300 s time constants and positive resistances. Pulse SOC is inferred from pre-pulse rest against C/20 reference. Measured cell-temperature coordinates.

SAMSUNG_30T.evidence_status: Calibration model; independent whole-test assessment pending
limitations: C/20 voltage is not measured equilibrium OCV.
Capacity is referenced to the C/20 discharge counter. Pulse starting SOC is inferred and inherits pseudo-OCV uncertainty; HPPC charge-return counters are not integrated as one global SOC trajectory.
Fixed time constants and SOC-local regression are approximations.
Temperature sensor accuracy is stated as +/-1 C; voltage/current accuracy is 0.1 percent of channel full scale.
Reversible heat is omitted because no independently sourced entropy coefficient is supplied.
Below the near-zero-temperature calibration condition, this model failed the development voltage budget; colder operation is not enabled.
No ageing, batch variability or module/thermal validation.
